<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the only non‑aromatic carbon is the carbonyl at 196.40 ppm. All other 12 signals (137.56, 131.90, 130.00, 128.40, each appearing multiple times due to symmetry) fall in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). Therefore the molecule contains 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
